gloss: club; hobby group; association of enthusiasts

definitions.gloss: club; hobby group; association of like-minded people
definitions.explanation: An informal group or club of people who share a common interest or hobby. Less formal than an official organization but more structured than a casual gathering.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}{同好会|どうこうかい}に{入|はい}った。
{会社|かいしゃ}の{登山|とざん}{同好会|どうこうかい}で{毎月|まいつき}{山|やま}に{登|のぼ}っている。
examples.english: I climb a mountain every month with the company's hiking club.

examples.japanese: {退職後|たいしょくご}に{絵画|かいが}{同好会|どうこうかい}を{立|た}ち{上|あ}げて、{同|おな}じ{趣味|しゅみ}の{仲間|なかま}と{交流|こうりゅう}している。
examples.english: After retirement, I started a painting club and socialize with others who share the same hobby.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in companies, schools, and community centers. Less formal than {部|ぶ} (department/official club) or {協会|きょうかい} (association). Often formed around hobbies like sports, arts, or cultural activities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同好会|どうこうかい}を{作|つく}る (to form a club)
- {同好会|どうこうかい}に{入|はい}る (to join a club)
- 〇〇{同好会|どうこうかい} (〇〇 club)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {部活|ぶかつ}: school club activity — more formal and structured, typically at schools
- サークル: circle — a casual group, especially at universities
